title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 27: the lamentation over Tyre, the ship built of the finest materials, and the nations that traded in her markets.

questions.text: What had Tyre said about herself?
questions.explanation: The lamentation says that Tyre, who dwells at the entry of the sea and is the merchant of the peoples, said: I am perfect in beauty.

answers.text: That she is the mother of nations
That she will stand for ever
That she is stronger than Babylon
That she is perfect in beauty

questions.text: From where was the cedar taken to make a mast for Tyre?
questions.explanation: The chapter says her planks were made of cypress trees from Senir, and that a cedar was taken from Lebanon to make a mast for her.

questions.text: Of what were Tyre's oars made?
questions.explanation: The chapter says they made her oars of the oaks of Bashan, and her benches of ivory inlaid in cypress wood from the islands of Kittim.

questions.text: Who were Tyre's rowers, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: It says the inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad were her rowers, and that her own wise men were her pilots.

answers.text: The men of Dedan and Kedar
The traders of Sheba and Raamah
The inhabitants of Sidon and Arvad
The old men of Gebal and Haran

questions.text: With which four metals did Tarshish trade for Tyre's wares?
questions.explanation: The chapter says Tarshish was her merchant because of the multitude of all kinds of riches, and traded for her wares with silver, iron, tin and lead.

answers.text: With gold, bronze, brass and salt
With gold, silver, coral and glass
With iron, copper, amber and pearls
With silver, iron, tin and lead

questions.text: What did the house of Togarmah trade for Tyre's wares?
questions.explanation: The chapter says that those of the house of Togarmah traded for her wares with horses, war horses and mules.

questions.text: What did Judah and the land of Israel trade for Tyre's merchandise?
questions.explanation: The chapter says Judah and the land of Israel were her traders, and traded wheat of Minnith, confections, honey, oil and balm for her merchandise.

questions.text: With what did the traders of Sheba and Raamah trade for Tyre's wares?
questions.explanation: The chapter says the traders of Sheba and Raamah traded for her wares with the chief of all spices, with all precious stones, and gold.

answers.text: With bright iron, cassia and calamus
With spices, precious stones and gold

questions.text: What broke Tyre in the heart of the seas?
questions.explanation: The chapter says her rowers brought her into great waters, and that the east wind broke her in the heart of the seas.

questions.text: What did the mourners say in their lamentation over Tyre?
questions.explanation: In their wailing they took up a lamentation, saying: Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?

answers.text: When will Tyre be built again?
Where are the ships of Tyre?
Why did Tyre leave the sea?
